First find the mean of the data set:
\[\frac{1}{8} (9 + 14 + 5 + 4 - 20 - 13 -5 + 13) = \frac{7}{8}.\]Then subtract the mean and square the result for each number in the list:
\begin{align*}
(9 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{1241}{64}, \\
(14 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{1764}{64}, \\
(5 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{729}{64}, \\
(4 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{625}{64}, \\
(-20 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{441}{64}, \\
(-13 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{324}{64}, \\
(-5 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{169}{64}, \\
(13 - \frac{7}{8})^2 &= \frac{1536}{64}.
\end{align*}Then take the average of these numbers and simplify:
\[\frac{1}{8} \left(\frac{1241}{64} + \frac{1764}{64} + \frac{729}{64} + \frac{625}{64} + \frac{441}{64} + \frac{324}{64} + \frac{169}{64} + \frac{1536}{64}\right) = \frac{1}{8} \cdot \frac{6819}{8} = \boxed{\frac{6819}{64}}.\]
